policy.manifest_trusted_axioms: metadata_only; neither a proof nor a consistency claim
policy.nonstandard_unreviewed_axiom: present in source; no independent standard proof or consistency claim
policy.opaque_abstract_interface: bodyless external type/function; absence of semantic laws does not validate parser, crypto, IO, or operational behavior
policy.abstract_interface_axiom: still an actual kernel axiom even when it only supplies an external object/function
policy.standard_derived_theorem_or_definition: specialist candidate Lean compilation reports only listed standard axioms; final leanchecker status is separate
policy.nonformal_declaration: present on disk but outside formal local import closure; never silently counted as a formal assumption
policy.historical_false: applies only to recorded old source/assumption; conditional refutations are not current False or correctness certificates
policy.historical_hashes: historical_source_sha256 and hashes embedded inside referenced specialist/amendment evidence retain their original raw-byte encoding; they are not silently converted or claimed as portable LF hashes.
policy.semantic_audit: Pinned-source type/premise review and concrete boundary tests are separate from full source-model faithfulness, whole-environment consistency, general algorithm correctness, and final leanchecker acceptance.
